jobs.description:
Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy ... 1 Head of Order Management (m/f/d) Medium Power Transformers A Snapshot of Your Day

As Head of Order Management (m/f/d) Medium Power Transformers, you lead the organization responsible for managing the factory's customer order portfolio within an Engineering-to-Order business. You ensure the successful execution of projects from order intake to delivery, meeting targets for schedule, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction. In addition, you drive the transformation of the order management organization by strengthening project management excellence, advancing digitalization, and continuously improving processes and standards. In close collaboration with customers, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, sales, and senior management, you contribute significantly to operational performance, profitability, and sustainable business growth.

How You'll Make an Impact

 * Lead, develop, and inspire the Order Management organization, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a high-performance culture.
 * Ensure the successful execution of the project portfolio in close collaboration with Commercial Project Management (CPM), managing project performance, risks, opportunities, profitability, quality, and customer satisfaction.
 * Drive organizational and process transformation, including the implementation of best practices, digitalization initiatives, and standardized project management methodologies.
 * Establish and continuously improve project management standards, governance, milestones, and quality gates in alignment with global business requirements.

What You Bring

 * Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a comparable field.
 * Extensive leadership experience in project management, order management, or a comparable function within a complex manufacturing or Engineering-to-Order environment.
 * Proven track record in leading organizational change, transforming processes, and driving continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
 * Strong expertise in project, risk, contract, and stakeholder management, combined with excellent communication, moderation, and decision-making skills.
 * Fluent German and English language skills and experience working successfully in an international and intercultural business environment.

At Siemens Energy we offer competitive compensation and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Due to the Austrian legal regulations, we are obliged to state the minimum salary for this position. Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. The minimum salary for this position in the collective agreement for the electrical and electronics industry is in the amount of € 84.028,28 gross/year for a full-time position, plus an All-In agreement including a variable compensation component.

1 Process Engineer (all genders) Job-ID: 203254 I Work Location Model: On-site I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

The impact you'll make
As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomicprecision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your roleinvolves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware tomeet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements toensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial roleour customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductorbreakthroughs.

In this role you will directly contribute to panel level processes. This is includes electrochemicalmetal deposition and post plating processes, e.g. metal etching. You will focus on developing process for and with customers around the world and cover smallscale and panel level scale processes.

What you'll do
 * Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam's cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems
 * Review and enhance processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture and fabrication of products
 * Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields
 * Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications
 * Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications
 * Partner cross-functionally and with customers to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges
 * Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap
 * Provide leadership, clear direction, and guidance to process technicians to support execution activities

Who we're looking for
Minimum Qualifications:

 * Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 6+ years of experience; or a PhD with 3+ years' experience; or equivalent experience
 * Good English oral and written communication skills
 * Structured and organized working style
 * Ability to work independently, high degree of flexibility and capable to work in a crossfunctional environment

Preferred Qualifications:

 * Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques
 * In-depth understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE)
 * Highly proficient in MATLAB, Python, or other similar scientific computing language
 * Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies
 * Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)
 * Background in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD), or Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD)
 * Background in Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP)
 * Knowledge of Material synthesis and material characterization
 * Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners
 * Experience in semiconductor, process design, deposition, etch dielectrics or conductor, metal films, etc.

What we're offering

1 Principal AI Engineer Your Tasks
 * Being part of SQUER means driving solutions in client projects and actively shaping SQUER with your knowledge.
 * Lead our clients in their AI adoption, develop their AI vision and target picture, and translate both into a concrete, prioritised transformation roadmap.
 * You will support several teams by solving complex challenges of both frontend and backend development.
 * You will be responsible for introducing or improving the AI-usage in the SDLC across the engineering teams of our clients and successfully deliver software solutions together.
 * You can communicate openly and are a team player.
 * You are actively involved in all phases of software development in an interdisciplinary manner and are happy to share your knowledge with your colleagues as a sparring partner and coach.
 * You are an active member of mostly agile SCRUM teams and spread SQUER culture with the aim of constant improvement.

Your Qualifications
 * Your experience and big-picture-thinking allows you to create solutions that generate a sustainable impact for our clients. 
 * You are a rolemodel in the usage of AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality and you are proficient in guiding teams in their AI adoption.
 * You have several years of experience within software architecture, cloud-native development and containerization (Docker or Kubernetes). You would like to deepen your knowledge in this field.
 * You have solid knowledge of frontend and backend development and relevant trends within this area excite you.
 * You have a hands-on mentality and are proficient in one or more programming languages in the Java ( Java, Kotlin, Scala, Clojure, ...), Javascript (Javascript, Typescript) or cloud-native environment (Rust, Go, ...).
 * You continuously improve the AI-adoption along the entire SDLC, resolve bottlenecks and feel passionate about enabling software teams in all their disciplines.
 * Trainings and development of your skills are highly important to you. Moreover, you enjoy passing on acquired knowledge.
 * You are fluent in English and German (written and spoken) in order to communicate in the best way possible with colleagues and partners.

Your Benefits

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy.
